title: Mr 9
desc: A Bangladeshi spy Masud Rana (MR9) teams up with a CIA operative to bring down an international terrorist group headed by a ruthless businessman. MR-9 travels to the US where he encounters Devi, a beautiful TLF agent. MR-9 and Devi flee to MR-9's secret safe house in the desert. During interrogation, they learn the TLF plans to bomb the Kaptai Dam in Bangladesh and Hoover Dam in the US.

title: Poseidon Rex
desc: While searching for lost treasure, deep sea divers unleash a monster that causes havoc and destruction not only in sea but also on land.

title: Haywire
desc: From Academy Award-winning director Steven Soderbergh of Ocean’s 11, 12 & 13 comes HAYWIRE. A Female Assassin covert operative is hired to various global missions to perform jobs which governments can't authorize. When the operation goes awry, she needs to use all of her skills & tricks to escape an international manhunt and eliminate the last remaining link of the conspiracy against her.

title: The Descent
desc: Six girlfriends, a deep cave expedition going horribly wrong, suffocating miles under the surface of Earth, breed of predators smells their skin.
